items.prompt:

A giraffe is the tallest animal in the world. Its long neck helps it reach leaves at the tops of trees that other animals cannot reach.

WHAT does a giraffe's long neck help it reach?
A) Water in a river
B) Leaves at the tops of trees
C) Grass on the ground
D) Insects in the sand
items.answer: B) Leaves at the tops of trees

steps: The question asks WHAT the neck helps it reach.
The passage says the neck helps it "reach leaves at the tops of trees."
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Leaves at the tops of trees

Earthworms may seem plain, but they are helpers for farmers. As a worm tunnels through the ground, it makes small holes that let air and water reach plant roots. The worm also eats old leaves and leaves behind waste that makes the soil rich. Because of this, plants grow better where worms live.

Which detail best explains WHY plants grow better where worms live?
A) Worms are plain and small
B) Worms scare away birds
C) Worms loosen the soil and leave waste that makes it rich
D) Worms come out when it rains
items.answer: C) Worms loosen the soil and leave waste that makes it rich

steps: The question asks WHY plants grow better with worms.
Worms make "holes that let air and water reach plant roots" and "leave behind waste that makes the soil rich."
That is the detail that explains it, so C.
solution.answer: C) Worms loosen the soil and leave waste that makes it rich
